Theme

Clothes & getting dressed

outfit noun

also attire, costume, uniform, in uniform, get-up

classical

Lewis & Short s.v. habitus II: dress, attire (Cic., Liv.)
Traupman 116, 118
Traupman 292

habitus, habitūs m.

noun, fourth declension

dress, attire; the outfit of a class or occasion; a uniform

Other words

  • synthesis, synthesis f. — a set of clothes, a suit (see suit)

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Mart. 2.46.4 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 117

  • subōrnātus, subōrnāta, subōrnātum — dressed up, fitted out (as)

    also used · classical · Sen. Ben. 3.28.4: in mīlitum cultum subōrnātī (Lewis & Short); Traupman 118: in uniform; Traupman 400

    Traupman’s “in uniform”; in Seneca it needs the outfit named: in mīlitum cultum subōrnātī, dressed up as soldiers.

See also clothes, suit.
